description:
Four dogfood examples, each in its own directory under examples/, that demonstrate one
Filament capability and serve as the test substrate imported by Track H.

  G1 — TodoList (examples/todo/)
       defcomponent, props, use_state, event closures, keyed list rendering.
       No GenServers, no observables. Establishes the project structure pattern.

  G2 — Cart & Checkout (examples/cart/)
       Cart.Server implementing Filament.Observable.GenServer with two projections:
       CartBadge (item count only) and CartView (full state). Direct GenServer
       mutations from event closures. Validates projection-prevents-re-render.

  G3 — Inventory holds (examples/inventory/)
       Inventory.Server implementing Filament.Hold.GenServer. CheckoutLineItem
       calls use_hold/3 and renders checkout button or out-of-stock message.
       Process death releases hold immediately — no TTL, no cleanup job.

  G4 — Collaboration locks (examples/collaboration/)
       Document.Server combining Filament.Hold.GenServer (one edit-lock slot) with
       Filament.Observable.GenServer (presence count = monitored PID count). Lock
       release and presence decrement happen atomically on :DOWN.

Project structure principle (CRITICAL — read before G1):
  Each example is a real Mix project under examples/<name>/ that can run standalone
  with `cd examples/<name> && mix phx.server`. Each example's mix.exs depends on
  filament via `{:filament, path: "../../"}`.

  For tests, the main filament/mix.exs expands elixirc_paths(:test) to include each
  example's lib/ directory. This compiles example modules as part of the test build
  WITHOUT creating a circular Mix dependency (circular deps are disallowed by Mix and
  would happen if filament mix.exs listed {:todo, path: "examples/todo/"} as a dep).

  Only the lib/ directory is included in elixirc_paths — not config/, mix.exs, or
  priv/. The example modules import Filament.* which is always available.

Prerequisites:
  Track B (flm-t8j) fully merged — defcomponent, use_state, ~F sigil, fiber tree
  Track C (flm-oue) fully merged — reconciler, RenderContext, Hooks framework
  Track D (flm-hom) fully merged — use_observable, Observable.GenServer, notify_observers
  Track E (flm-zoc) fully merged — use_hold, Hold.GenServer, defevent, event closures
  (Tracks B, C, D are already fully closed. Track E is in progress.)

Track G is a prerequisite for Track H (tests exercising these examples).
Track I (docs) references these examples as narrative substrate.

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html §03 (Examples section)
title: Track G: Examples — four standalone Phoenix apps demonstrating Filament capabilities
